changelog:
Poe API Orchestration Skill v1.0.0

- Initial release enabling OpenClaw to access and route requests across 300+ AI models via the Poe API.
- Features intelligent model selection and cost optimization based on task type.
- Supports querying for text, image, video, audio generation, and AI-assisted web search.
- Provides detailed task-model mapping tables and usage guidance.
- Includes quickstart code examples and principles for effective model usage.
summary: Enable intelligent querying of 300+ AI models via Poe API with automatic model selection, task-based routing, and cost-quality optimization.
